items.title: Don Menza and Sam Noto interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, January 28, 1997
items.q: And we remained friends to the day he died.

ctx.x: Yes. And after Maynard’s band it was such a letdown for me, that I called Maynard, I tried to get my job back and Maynard was furious with me for leaving. And Stan was very sweet. He says, “I understand perfectly.” And I didn’t tell him it ain’t swinging, I said, “This isn’t what I wanted to do.” And I told him I said, “I have the greatest deal of respect for you,” and we remained friends to the day he died.
It’s also interesting that he left, from what I read, he left instructions that he did not want a ghost band.
